name: 米高芬
prompt: Battle sprite correction. Repose this exact teddy bear into a STRICT RIGHT-FACING SIDE VIEW, standing idle upright. The muzzle/nose must project to the RIGHT, near eye visible and far eye mostly hidden; torso belly points RIGHT, both feet point RIGHT. Keep head, body and feet in the same right-facing direction, NOT frontal or looking at camera. Arms gently lowered, stable two-foot stance, full body within vertical canvas. Preserve brown plush, button eyes, cream muzzle, ear patch, belly patch and sewn seams. Neutral soft lighting ON THE BEAR ONLY. REMOVE THE ENTIRE ORANGE/BROWN HALO around the bear. REMOVE ALL ambient glow, vignette, shadow, floor and backdrop pixels, including the warm mist between the legs and under feet. This is an isolated game character cutout: outside its precise cloth silhouette must have ALPHA ZERO, including the gap between legs. No background or simulated checkerboard. No opaque/partially-transparent brown gradients anywhere outside the bear. Retain only the teddy bear, clean antialiased silhouette edges, genuinely transparent RGBA. No text, frame, or other objects.

initial.prompt: Edit/repose the teddy bear in the supplied image into ONE production-ready BATTLE CHARACTER CUTOUT with a genuinely TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. Keep the exact original brown plush identity: honey-brown cloth, round ears with repaired dark ear patch, dark round button eyes sewn with X threads, cream muzzle, small dark triangular embroidered nose, stitched mouth, central sewn seam and small dark rectangular belly patch, mitten plush paws and big padded feet. Change the pose and camera entirely: FULL BODY UPRIGHT IDLE STANDING, on the same ground level as enemies, body, head, muzzle and BOTH FEET all oriented toward SCREEN RIGHT. Use a clear right-facing side/three-quarter view, about 70 degrees turned away from frontal toward the right, so the muzzle projects to the RIGHT and gaze looks RIGHT, never at the viewer or to the left. Left-to-right gameplay ally orientation. Both feet planted firmly, short plush legs slightly apart in a stable natural stance; both padded arms lowered with elbows gently bent, near paw slightly forward in a quiet protective ready stance. No punch, no walking stride, no leaning toward the camera, no exaggerated foreshortening. Eye-level gameplay camera and neutral proportions. Ears, paws and feet fully inside canvas with small transparent safety margins; large readable bear silhouette, centered in a vertical 2:3 canvas. Preserve the existing hand-painted anime fabric rendering and sewn construction, but keep large quiet cloth color planes and selective brushwork so the small in-game figure reads cleanly; no uniformly scratchy texture. Soft warm-neutral light from upper left, cool restrained brown shadows, modest highlights, no dramatic orange backlight. REMOVE ALL backdrop paint, ground plane, ground/contact shadow, cast shadow outside silhouette, glow, smoke and particles. Every pixel outside the teddy bear itself must be truly transparent alpha, including between limbs. Do not draw any checkerboard pattern or white/colored background. No card frame, writing, props, weapons, accessories or human anatomy. Final output is only this right-facing standing plush bear battle sprite on transparency.

requirements: Full body standing toward screen right
processing: WebP RGBA encoding with transparent safety margin; card art unchanged
